sentences.text: The documents do not state any instructions in the Gold Loan FAQ about what the AI assistant should say regarding pre-payment (pre-closure) or any associated charges/disclosures.
The FAQ evidence only identifies the document as a Gold Loan FAQ and gives its last updated date of 15 January 2026, but it does not include any pre-payment instructions.

The related loan documents say pre-payment or pre-closure means repayment of a loan, in full or in part, before its scheduled due date, and one agreement says the Borrower may pre-pay the Loan, in full or in part, at any time after giving seven days' written notice to the branch.

The related loan documents also state a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on pre-payment or foreclosure, while a superseded RBI direction said the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement.
